name: labs/amsikking__thorlabs_mcm3000
title: Thorlabs MCM3000 series 3-axis controller
intro: Thorlabs MCM3000 series 3-axis controller, adapted from amsikking/thorlabs_mcm3000. It reads `position_ch0`, `position_ch1` and `position_ch2`; runs `move_channel` and `stop_motion`. `move_channel`: move one configured controller channel to a position in micrometres and report the position the controller reads back. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
